verdict.rationale: Open-licensed design sources are a fair axis for processors, since open hardware designs exist, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the M4 Pro's own design or firmware source is published under an open license. MLX being open-source is a separate software framework, not the product's source, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
